_help: Edit these to match your airframe. All values are used by the analysis and the tuning advisor.

motor_layout._help: Physical position of each motor index as logged (dianji[0] = motor_1). Confirmed by user: M1 front-right, M2 front-left, M3 rear-left, M4 rear-right.

tuning._help: ADRC b0 values used on THIS flight (from the GCS). Leave null if unknown; the tool then reads the value back from the log where possible.
tuning._higher_b0_means_help: ADRC law u = (u0 - z3)/b0: a larger |b0| gives a smaller output -> softer. Confirm with one test flight: +0.25 should feel lazier.
